Reorder Menu reached category reordering. Before MLRC-194, the rendered Drag to reorder button ignored Space/Enter plus arrow keys because the DnD context registered pointer and touch sensors only. After adding the existing dnd-kit KeyboardSensor with sortable keyboard coordinates, Space then ArrowUp moved Drinks over the temporary category, exposed pressed/live-region feedback, and Space dropped it. Save persisted the order through the acknowledged MLRC-193 boundary. The empty category remained omitted from public rendering throughout and was then deleted, restoring the exact one-category fixture. The adjacent Reorder items path selected Drinks, moved a disposable RC Reorder Tea above Filter Coffee using the same keyboard sequence, saved the order, and a fresh public menu rendered that order. Deleting the disposable item in 1.8 seconds restored the exact Filter Coffee at ₹80 owner/public fixture. The current continuation additionally verified the shared Popup's dynamic Categories, Reorder Menu, Reorder categories, and Reorder items names. Selecting Drinks reproduced MLRC-312's missing-key error on the Missing image legend; after stable semantic keys were added, the exact Filter Coffee review rendered cleanly with no issue overlay and returned through both Back states without Save.
